spans.s: pl. N. of a school, Divyāv. (g. कार्त-कौजपादि).
a follower of Cārvāka, a materialist, atheist, R.

mf(ई)n. (fr. लोक) worldly, terrestrial, belonging to or occurring in ordinary life, common, usual, customary, temporal, not sacred (as opp. to वैदिक, आर्ष, शास्त्रीय ; लौकिकेषु ind. = लोके ‘in ordinary or popular speech’, opp. to वैदिकेषु, Nir.), ŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
(ifc.) belonging to the world of (cf. ब्रह्म-ल्˚)
common or ordinary men (as opp. to ‘the learned, initiated’ &c.), Śaṃk.; Sarvad.
men familiar with the ways of the world, men of the world, Uttarar.
men in general, people, mankind, MBh.
anything occurring in the world, general custom, usage, Śak.; MārkP.
a person's ordinary occupation, BhP.
ind., = लोके ‘in ordinary or popular speech’, opp. to वैदिकेषु, Nir.
लौकिक—ज्ञ mfn. knowing the ways of the world, Śak.
लौकिक—त्व n. worldliness, commonness, usual custom, general prevalence, Sāh.
लौकिक—न्याय m. a general rule or maxim
लौकिक—न्याय—मुक्तावली f. N. of wk.
लौकिक—न्याय—रत्नाकर m. N. of wk.
लौकिक—न्याय—संग्रह m. N. of wk.
लौकिक—भान-वाद-रहस्य n. N. of wk.

लौकिक—विषयता-विचार m. N. of wk.
लौक्य᳙ mfn. belonging to the world, mundane, AV.
extended through the world, generally diffused, MBh.
general, usual, common, commonplace, ib.
लौक्य᳙ m. N. of a man, ŚāṅkhŚr.
